about: Every live run of Walmart #3891 Pickup that this repository publishes. The nine 1.5.x stages are the owner-funded campaign of 2026-10-31 (releases 1.5.0 and 1.5.1), with the values the 1.5.2 publication gave them and repository paths. The 1.6.x stages are the user-trial campaign oxylabs-trial-20261103 (2026-11-03/04; releases 1.6.0 to 1.6.4 and the final 1.6.5): each entry is computed from the run's own evidence in evidence/live/1.6.x/runs/ and from the shared trial ledger's reservations of its stage (evidence/live/1.6.x/campaign/shared_ledger/). A run's status is the collector's: 'rejected' means a release gate failed (G3, coverage, at least: no run read the whole catalogue), so nothing was published. products.valid_fresh is the run's own count of valid fresh records (its validation report); a run that stopped before its validation (L4, L6, L7) has none, and products.fresh_rows_exported is the number of fresh rows its export holds. products_retained is the run's products.json: its fresh rows plus the rows it carried from earlier runs, each with its own observation date. USD amounts are at the reserve rate (USD 0.0015 per result, a list price), not an invoice.

1.6.x.allowance: USD 5 in total for Walmart and Mariano's together (the trial's free credit), envelopes USD 2.25 each and USD 0.50 headroom
